messages:
Alex Kim: Pushed a small PR to tidy the Python quickstart example and clarify the auth paragraph — mostly wording + one code fence fix. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Sara V: Taking a look now, should be quick :eyes:
Mohit Patel: Quick heads-up: the example uses `token` in the prose, we usually say `API key` in docs. Also the snippet has `sh` fence but uses Python prompt style.
Alex Kim: Good catch — updated both in the branch. I changed the paragraph to 'use your API key' and switched the fence to ```python
# example snippet
client = Redwood(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
```
Sara V: lgtm overall, one tiny nit: could you add a one-line note about streaming not being supported in that quickstart? prevents confusion later.
Alex Kim: Added a short sentence and a link to streaming guide. pushed again.
Jen L: Looks clean to me, approving now. :thumbsup: Merge when CI passes.
docs-bot: Preview site updated: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/quickstart (build passed)
Alex Kim: Thanks all — will merge after one more approval or green CI. If no objections I'll merge at EOD.
